title: Single hieratic sign, Turin, Museo Egizio, CGT 54050 (AKU HT 43374)

source.attribution: Facsimile by Giuseppina Lenzo; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 43374

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 43374; AKU grapheme L0010 (AKU GR 337). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: L1 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 258. Source publication of this facsimile: Lenzo 2011. Occurrence: line 5; find place Deir el-Medina; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 6.9 x 6.5 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Neues Reich, 20. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (Kooperationspartner), by Giuseppina Lenzo. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
